transcript.content: Hello, it's nice to meet you. What brings you in today?

Nice to meet you too, doctor. Well, I suppose what brings me in is that my wife thinks I'm not eating enough. But honestly, most days I just have some coffee and toast in the morning, and... maybe a little soup or some vegetables later on. Big meals just feel unnecessary at my age.
Are you afraid of gaining weight?

Well, yes, I suppose I am. When my wife tries to put butter on things, or if she serves me a full plate, I do get nervous. I just worry that I'll start putting weight back on and... well, lose the control I've worked so hard to keep.
Has your weight become significantly low for your height and age?

Well, my regular doctor says the number on the scale has gotten too low for a man my age. He brought it up recently. But honestly, to me... being lighter just makes it easier to get around the garden and keep up on my daily walks. I feel like it helps me stay active, even if the doctors think it's too low.
Have you ever made yourself vomit after eating?

No, no, I've never done anything like that. I just... well, I prefer to control what goes on my plate to begin with, so I don't really have a reason to do that. But no, I've never made myself throw up.
Do you ever have episodes where you feel unable to control how much you eat, consuming an unusually large amount of food?

No, I can't say I do. I mean, like I said, I'm very careful about what I eat and how much goes on my plate. I don't really have those moments where I just eat and eat without stopping. That's just... that's not something that happens to me.
When you look at your body, do you feel that you are overweight or that your weight or shape strongly affects how you judge yourself?

Well, I wouldn't say I feel overweight, exactly. But... my shape definitely dictates how I feel about myself on any given day. Like, if I put my trousers on and my belt feels a notch looser, I feel good. I feel like I've done right by myself. But if I catch a glimpse in the mirror and my stomach looks the least bit rounded... I just feel sloppy. I get very disappointed in myself. So, yes, it matters a lot to me.
